title: 택배 받기·보내기: 기본 표현
summary: Short phrases for receiving and sending parcels in Korea: checking the recipient, asking for the tracking number, accepting or refusing a parcel, and sending one.
objective: Understand and say 10 short sentences for receiving and sending parcels at a counter or with a courier.
exercises: Answer in Korean (use the name 김민수): 수취인 성함이 어떻게 되세요?
Say in Korean: 'I want to send a package.'
Ask in Korean: 'What is the tracking number?'
The parcel is damaged. Refuse it briefly in Korean.
Reply in Korean that you will sign: 서명해 주세요.
answers: 예시 답안 (Sample answer): 저는 김민수입니다. / Also correct: 김민수입니다.
예시 답안 (Sample answer): 택배로 보내고 싶습니다. / Also correct: 택배로 보내고 싶어요. / 택배 보내고 싶어요. / 택배 보내려고요.
예시 답안 (Sample answer): 운송장 번호가 어떻게 되나요? / Also correct: 운송장 번호가 뭐예요?
예시 답안 (Sample answer): 이건 받을 수 없어요. / Also correct: 받을 수 없어요. / 파손돼서 못 받겠어요.
예시 답안 (Sample answer): 여기 서명할게요. / Also correct: 서명할게요. / 네, 서명할게요. / 네, 여기 서명할게요.

sections.heading: Key expressions (10)
paragraphs: 1) 택배 받으러 왔습니다. (I'm here to pick up a parcel.) — Used when you pick up a parcel yourself at the counter. 택배 = parcel, courier delivery.
2) 수취인 성함이 어떻게 되세요? (What is the recipient's name?) — Asked by the clerk or driver to check the recipient's name. 수취인 = recipient; 성함 = name (polite).
3) 저는 [이름]입니다. (I am [name].) — The recipient's answer, e.g. 저는 김민수입니다.
4) 운송장 번호가 어떻게 되나요? (What is the tracking number?) — Asks for the tracking (waybill, 송장) number. 운송장 = waybill, the shipping slip with the tracking number.
5) 운송장 번호 알려 주세요. (Please tell me the tracking number.) — Used to ask someone for the tracking number.
6) 여기 서명할게요. (I'll sign here.) — Used when signing. 서명 = signature.
7) 이건 받을 수 없어요. (I can't accept this.) — Used to refuse a parcel, e.g. when it is 파손 (damaged).
8) 택배로 보내고 싶습니다. (I want to send a package.) — Said when you come to send something.
9) 보낼 물건은 이거예요. (This is the item I want to send.) — Used when showing the item you want to send. 물건 = item, thing.

10) 착불로 보내 주세요. (Please send it with shipping paid by the recipient.) — Asks to send it so that the recipient pays the shipping fee on arrival. 착불 = shipping fee paid by the recipient (freight collect).

sections.heading: Short dialogues
paragraphs: Example 1 (receiving): Driver: '수취인 성함이 어떻게 되세요?' (What is the recipient's name?) / Me: '저는 김민수입니다.' (I am Kim Minsu.)
Example 2 (sending): Me: '택배로 보내고 싶습니다.' (I want to send a package.) / Clerk: '보내실 물건이 뭐예요?' (What would you like to send?) / Me: '보낼 물건은 이거예요.' (This is the item I want to send.)

sections.heading: Tips
paragraphs: Before accepting a parcel, quickly check the packaging, and refuse it right away if there is a problem.
To speak politely, add '요' after the casual informal ending (-아/어, -지, etc.): 받을 수 없어 → 받을 수 없어요. You cannot add '요' to just any ending (not 받을 수 없다요).

sections.heading: More speaking practice
paragraphs: You are at the counter to pick up your parcel. What do you say? → 택배 받으러 왔습니다.
The clerk asks what you want to send. Show the item. → 보낼 물건은 이거예요.
You want the recipient to pay the shipping fee. → 착불로 보내 주세요.

note: For beginners: say each expression out loud several times.
